mcqs.q: Which classical dance form originated in Andhra Pradesh?
mcqs.exp: Kuchipudi originated in the Kuchipudi village of Krishna district, Andhra Pradesh.

mcqs.q: Where is the Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SHAR) located?
mcqs.exp: Satish Dhawan Space Centre is ISRO's primary spaceport located in Sriharikota, Tirupati district, AP.

mcqs.q: What is the state animal of Andhra Pradesh?
mcqs.exp: The Blackbuck (Krishna Jinka) is the official state animal of Andhra Pradesh.

mcqs.q: Which major river forms a massive delta at Rajahmundry before entering the Bay of Bengal?
mcqs.exp: The Godavari River flows through Rajahmundry (Rajamahendravaram) and forms its fertile delta region.

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Andhra Pradesh.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Amaravati. Andhra Pradesh covers a geographic area of 162,968 sq km across 26 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Godavari, Krishna, Penna, Tungabhadra.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: First state formed on a linguistic basis in India (1953). Known as the 'Rice Bowl of India', home to Sriharikota spaceport (SDSC SHAR) and the Tirumala Venkateswara Temple.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Andhra Pradesh.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Andhra Pradesh was formally instituted on 1 November 1956. Official language(s): Telugu.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Kuchipudi (Classical Dance).

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Ugadi, Sankranti, Tirupati Brahmotsavam.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Andhra Pradesh.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is S. Abdul Nazeer.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh is N. Chandrababu Naidu.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under High Court of Andhra Pradesh (Amaravati).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Blackbuck | State Bird: Rose-ringed parakeet | State Flower: Jasmine | State Tree: Neem.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Andhra Pradesh.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Mica, Bauxite, Limestone, Uranium (Tummalapalle).

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Andhra Pradesh plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Andhra Pradesh.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Tirumala Venkateswara Temple, Lepakshi Temple, Amaravati Stupa, Borra Caves.

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Papikonda National Park, Sri Venkateswara National Park.

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Andhra Pradesh.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Thalliki Vandanam, Annadata Sukhibhava, Deepam Scheme.
